evidenceContribution.rationale: Memo del Brigadier General Carroll H. Bolender (Director of Aerospace Programs, USAF) que explícitamente reconoce: 'reports of UFOs which could affect national security are made in accordance with JANAP 146 or Air Force Manual 55-11, and are NOT part of the Blue Book system.' Es la confesión institucional documentada de un programa paralelo clasificado de seguimiento UAP fuera del cauce público de Blue Book — uno de los pocos memos donde la USAF admite por escrito la existencia de un sistema dual (público sanitizado + clasificado real). Substantial supports porque el documento es identificación textual del encubrimiento institucional, no inferencia.
evidenceContribution.rationaleEn: Memo by Brigadier General Carroll H. Bolender (Director of Aerospace Programs, USAF) that explicitly states: 'reports of UFOs which could affect national security are made in accordance with JANAP 146 or Air Force Manual 55-11, and are NOT part of the Blue Book system.' It is the documented institutional confession of a parallel classified UAP tracking program outside Blue Book's public channel — one of the few memos where USAF admits in writing the existence of a dual system (sanitized public + real classified). Substantial supports because the document is textual identification of institutional cover-up, not inference.

whatHappened:
El 20 de octubre de 1969, el Brigadier General Carroll Bolender, Deputy Director de Development en el USAF Office of Aerospace Research, envió un memorándum interno preparatorio para el cierre administrativo de Project Blue Book (que efectivamente ocurrió en diciembre 1969).

El párrafo crítico del memo establece textualmente: 'Reports of UFOs which could affect national security are made in accordance with JANAP 146 or Air Force Manual 55-11, and are not part of the Blue Book system.' Esta declaración confirma documentalmente — desde la institución USAF — que el sistema público de investigación de UFOs (Blue Book) operaba en paralelo con un canal clasificado distinto reservado para casos con implicancias de seguridad nacional.

JANAP 146 es el Joint Army-Navy-Air Force Publication para reportes de objetos hostiles o no identificados en el espacio aéreo continental; AFM 55-11 es el manual de Communications Instructions for Reporting Vital Intelligence Sightings (CIRVIS). Ambos canales tienen clasificación operacional y no archivan en Blue Book. El memo Bolender es la confirmación más explícita disponible del sistema dual.
whatHappened_en:
On October 20, 1969, Brigadier General Carroll Bolender, Deputy Director of Development at the USAF Office of Aerospace Research, sent an internal memorandum preparing the administrative closure of Project Blue Book (which effectively occurred in December 1969).

The memo's critical paragraph reads verbatim: 'Reports of UFOs which could affect national security are made in accordance with JANAP 146 or Air Force Manual 55-11, and are not part of the Blue Book system.' This statement documents — from inside the USAF — that the public UFO investigation system (Blue Book) operated in parallel with a distinct classified channel reserved for cases with national security implications.

JANAP 146 is the Joint Army-Navy-Air Force Publication governing reports of hostile or unidentified objects in continental airspace; AFM 55-11 is the manual of Communications Instructions for Reporting Vital Intelligence Sightings (CIRVIS). Both channels carry operational classification and do not file into Blue Book. The Bolender memo is the most explicit available confirmation of the dual system.
whyMatters: Documento bisagra para la metodología institucional: confirma que el cierre de Blue Book en 1969 no implicó el cierre de la investigación gubernamental del fenómeno UAP — solo el cierre de su canal público. Los reportes con implicancias de seguridad nacional siguieron fluyendo por JANAP 146 / CIRVIS sin trazabilidad pública. Establece el piso documental para investigaciones posteriores sobre programas compartimentados (AAWSAP, AATIP, UAPTF, Grusch testimony).
whyMatters_en: A pivot document for institutional methodology: it confirms that the 1969 closure of Blue Book did not mean the end of government UAP investigation — only the closure of its public channel. Reports with national security implications continued to flow through JANAP 146 / CIRVIS without public traceability. It establishes the documentary floor for subsequent investigations of compartmented programs (AAWSAP 2008+, AATIP 2007+).
evidence: Memorándum Bolender original (20 octubre 1969) preservado y desclasificado
Cita textual confirmando canal paralelo JANAP 146 / AFM 55-11
Cierre Blue Book en diciembre 1969 — confirmación cronológica del propósito del memo
Continuidad documentada de programas posteriores (AAWSAP 2008+, AATIP 2007+)
evidence_en: Original Bolender memorandum (October 20, 1969) preserved and declassified
Verbatim quote confirming the parallel JANAP 146 / AFM 55-11 channel
Closure of Blue Book in December 1969 — chronological confirmation of the memo's purpose
Documented continuity of later programs (AAWSAP 2008+, AATIP 2007+)
